title: UsageEvent
description:
The neutral, cross-repo boundary object emitted once per model call.

**No dollars, no tier/SKU names.** Sandhi measures; the commercial layer prices (AnvaiOps ADR-0047 D3). Build with [`UsageEvent::new`] + the `with_*` setters.

attempts.description: Number of upstream attempts made by the runtime for this logical call.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the logical call in milliseconds, measured at the adapter boundary (includes retries; excludes host-side queueing).

gpu_seconds.description: Self-hosted backends only: GPU-seconds (the cost basis there).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-supplied key for at-most-once semantics across retries of one logical call.

outcome.description: Stable terminal outcome such as `success`, `error`, or `cancelled`.

parent_id.description: Parent step/run for nested agents, so an agent's cost tree is reconstructable.

provider.description: Neutral provider slug (anthropic, openai, gemini, bedrock, cohere, vllm, ollama, byo…).

reasoning_included.description: True: included in tokens_out; false: separate. Absent preserves legacy accounting.

reasoning_tokens.description: Provider-reported reasoning count (OpenAI `reasoning_tokens`, Gemini `thoughtsTokenCount`). Inclusion in output is specified by `reasoning_included`; absent when no separate count is reported.

run_id.description: Agent-run identifier; groups every call one run makes (cost-tree root).

schema_version.description: Wire-contract major version. Breaking changes bump this and coordinate consumers.

session_id.description: Conversation/session key for prompt-cache + KV affinity (ADR-0047 D9). Preserved end-to-end; never collapsed to a single value.

step_id.description: Step within a run; child dimension under `run_id`.

time_to_first_token_ms.description: Streams only: milliseconds from request start to the first delivered item.

trace_context.description: W3C `traceparent` value, linking the event into distributed traces.

upstream_request_id.description: Provider-supplied request identifier when one was returned.

usage_basis.description: Whether those counts were measured or estimated (TD-0013 D5). Orthogonal to `usage_completeness`: an interrupted stream may carry real provider counts or a byte-derived floor, and only this field tells a consumer which.

usage_completeness.description: Whether token counts are final, partial, or unavailable for this logical call.

Backend.description: The cost basis of a call's backend.

oneOf.description: Local vLLM/TGI — billed in GPU-hours; token counts are display-only.

UsageBasis.description:
Where a usage number came from (TD-0013 D5).

Orthogonal to [`UsageCompleteness`], which answers *how complete* the counts are. This answers *whether they were measured at all* — and the two are genuinely independent: an interrupted stream can carry real provider counts (`Partial` + `ProviderReported`) or a byte-derived floor (`Partial` + `Estimated`), and today nothing on the wire tells them apart.

Deliberately a separate field rather than a fourth `UsageCompleteness` variant: redefining what `Partial` means would retroactively change the meaning of rows already written to operators' stores, without changing a single byte of schema. Adding a field does not.

oneOf.description: Every category came from the provider. The default, because it is what every code path that existed before this discriminator was introduced actually did.
At least one category was derived from a byte count rather than reported. Reached only when a stream ends before the family had reported that category — never on a completed call.
